readings.recorded: lanto, saivo po veseva fime raho saivo viki ke saivo de devorivo.
readings.issue: fime + headless raho has no predicate for the raho-phrase.
readings.standard_form: lanto, saivo po veseva fime saivo viki ke saivo de devorivo.
readings.note: Probable intent: drop raho (“whispered that he would be her betrothed”). Confirm with the author.

readings.recorded: maivo po ke baba lirasan lavra norusan.
readings.standard_form: maivo po ke baba norusan lirasan lavra.

readings.recorded: li linu raho navdinia sabesia baba bio de milno.
readings.issue: Relative clause not closed by a comma (1.0:G21).
readings.standard_form: li linu raho navdinia, sabesia baba bio de milno.

readings.recorded: maivo mambivimoma ala li ata masuma lanla ata po milobema.
readings.issue: li followed directly by ata; the phrase does not parse.
readings.note: Author to supply the intended line.

readings.recorded: kube ito futu ke salrusan maivo ata donuda ala ito baba biti vobi demro.
readings.issue: Appears to be a draft of the next line, which says the same thing correctly.
readings.note: Author to confirm whether the recorded vocal uses this line.

readings.recorded: voyu taivo de navu maivo ne povi navdinia maivo.
readings.standard_form: voyu taivo de navu maivo ne povi navdinia maivo sela.

readings.recorded: maivo futu senosia ala taivo de baba gargonasan colbi.
readings.issue: Pronoun + de reads as owner (1.2:G27): “your gentle colour”. Recipient order is VERB THEME ala RECIPIENT (1.2:G26).
readings.standard_form: maivo futu senosia baba gargonasan colbi ala taivo.

readings.recorded: maivo futu veseva ala taivo de li vera de damruna.
readings.issue: Same pronoun + de issue as the line above.
readings.standard_form: maivo futu veseva li vera de damruna ala taivo.

readings.recorded: li sabeasasan nelari raho pensapa peburalno en milno ki?
readings.issue: peburalno is the noun; the verb is peburalnopa. Relative needs a closing comma.
readings.standard_form: li sabeasasan nelari raho pensapa, peburalnopa en milno ki?

readings.recorded: si maivo ke sidu daigoda, maivo kopi daigoda en saivo de varori.
readings.issue: sidu never follows a copula (1.0 linking rule).
readings.standard_form: si maivo musi daigoda, maivo kopi daigoda en saivo de varori.
readings.note: Held question: ke sidu VERB as “destined to” (see open_questions).

readings.recorded: maivo po silbesia saivo de vaye raho po jubaja baba nonmori.
readings.issue: Pronoun + de reads as owner: “her wind”.
readings.standard_form: maivo po silbesia saivo baba vaye raho po jubaja baba nonmori.
readings.note: Use the standard form only if “her” was meant as the recipient.

readings.recorded: tonsi maivo po silbesia saivo de baba pagonasan folni.
readings.issue: Pronoun + de before baba reads as owner; recipient takes VERB PRONOUN THEME (1.2:G26).
readings.standard_form: tonsi maivo po silbesia saivo baba pagonasan folni.

readings.recorded: maivo po veseva ala saivo de li krotiata lirasarbi.
readings.issue: Pronoun + de reads as owner: “her next poem”.
readings.standard_form: maivo po veseva li krotiata lirasarbi ala saivo.

readings.recorded: saivo po farufasbifa kube saivo ramusan raho maivo po ke.
readings.issue: ramusan is the adjective (“memorable”); the verb is ramura. Headless raho is canon from 2.2:G64.
readings.standard_form: saivo po farufasbifa kube saivo ramura raho maivo po ke.

readings.recorded: maivo toda-krono po ke saivo de devorivo.
readings.issue: A time word stands first or last (1.2:G24), not between subject and tense.
readings.standard_form: maivo po ke saivo de devorivo toda-krono.

readings.recorded: raho povi sabesia baba kasi polvasan sove ki?
readings.issue: raho is relative only; the question word is ki-nela.
readings.standard_form: ki-nela povi sabesia baba kasi polvasan sove ki?
